label: PF Backlog 429
title: A3: PF platform build->package->deploy + compiled packaging + signing + SBOM/LBOM + NO-RAW-.py gate (absorbs BI-PF-0383)
body: [A3] One-time rebuildable pipeline: Nuitka (Python) + go build (Go) -> signed package + SBOM/LBOM; release gate = no readable source. Includes build-time plug/unplug.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/code_quality_gate.py, core/deploy_providers.py, core/merge_gate.py, core/model_gate.py

missing: Go core source status (committed or to be built)
context_review.reason: Existing packaging.py, signing.py, and gate modules provide clear extension points. The missing items are operational and policy decisions, not architectural blockers.

dependencies.required_state: EAP manifest schema approved and validator implemented

brief.problem: PF must be packaged as a compiled, signed artifact with no readable source, from a one-time rebuildable pipeline.
brief.what_adds: A3 — build->package->deploy pipeline: compiled packaging (Nuitka for Python + go build for Go) + signing + SBOM/LBOM + a no-raw-.py release gate. Absorbs BI-PF-0383 (build-time plug/unplug of the worker subsystem per edition).
brief.why: IP protection (no readable source) + supply-chain integrity (signing, SBOM/LBOM) + one source -> many editions.
brief.who_feels: PF platform maintainers, workers, and customers.

objective: A3 — build->package->deploy pipeline: compiled packaging (Nuitka for Python + go build for Go) + signing + SBOM/LBOM + a no-raw-.py release gate. Absorbs BI-PF-0383 (build-time plug/unplug of the worker subsystem per edition).
acceptance_criteria: release gate fails if a raw .py is shipped
approach: Wire a rebuildable pipeline that compiles Python (Nuitka) and Go (go build), signs, emits SBOM/LBOM, and fails the release gate if any raw .py is present; exclude the worker subsystem per edition at build time.
verification: release gate fails if a raw .py is shipped

api_impact.reason: no API surface declared in backend_capability
